name: Rail Dock Leveler Board 40000lb
instruction:
Plan fulfillment for these outstanding Rail Dock Leveler Board 40000lb orders to ensure timely deliveries:

- Orbital Productions: 26 units due in 9 days (pretax budget cap $288,719)
- Quartz Dynamics: 21 units due in 9 days (pretax budget cap $227,493)
- Stratos Institute: 21 units due in 11 days (pretax budget cap $234,249)
- Granite Atelier: 15 units due in 11 days (pretax budget cap $155,437)

- Riverdale Conservatory: 14 units due in 12 days (pretax budget cap $149,501)
- Trellis Media: 21 units due in 12 days (pretax budget cap $233,716)
- Silverline Bazaar: 24 units due in 12 days (pretax budget cap $269,902)
- Spire Innovations: 21 units due in 14 days (pretax budget cap $224,005)
- Forge Exchange: 21 units due in 14 days (pretax budget cap $227,167)

We have 36 finished units on hand.

Across all units covered through new purchasing or manufacturing, keep portfolio-level new-spend margin at or above 26% at selling price.
background_and_policy:
* Fulfill all orders while minimizing new spending on procurement and manufacturing.
* Any units you cover through new buying or manufacturing count toward one combined portfolio that must still meet a minimum 26% new-spend margin at selling price.
* Existing stock is a sunk cost and should not be treated as new spend.
* You must create and confirm the necessary sales orders, manufacturing orders, and any component purchase orders needed for assembly.
* Customer budgets are pre-tax amounts.
* Link Sales Orders to the related Manufacturing Orders and Purchase Orders for traceability.
* Use in-house manufacturing to cover finished-goods shortfalls; purchase orders are only for components.
* For component POs, put the MO reference(s) (e.g. WH/MO/00010 or WH/MO/00010, WH/MO/00011) into the origin field.
* For finished goods MOs, put the Sales Order reference (e.g. S00030) into the origin field ('Source' in the UI).
* In the end, the lineage must be SO -> MO -> PO.
* You must sell this product at List Price.
* On sales orders, set the commitment date.
* On manufacturing orders, you must set the start date and the due date.
* Procure only the components that are not in stock.
* On purchase orders, you must set the delivery date.
* Review Internal Notes/comments on stock, customers, vendors, and workcenters before you confirm entries in the ERP.

Capacity constraints:
- Treat workcenter capacity as a hard horizon-wide limit across all products that share the center.
- Check each workcenter's Internal Notes in Odoo for the exact horizon-wide minute limit.
- Assign workcenter on each manufacturing work order.
- For each component supplier offer, respect min/max quantities as horizon-wide totals.
- Use one consolidated PO per supplier offer (do not split a single offer across multiple POs).
- Check each vendor's Internal Notes in Odoo for maximum order quantity limits.
